issue_context.title: semantic_text does not support object fields

review_comments:
We got a two-for-one with this bug fix 😁 

Since the semantic text field type adds sub-objects to the mapping upon first document ingestion, it cannot be in an object field with subobjects disabled. Before this fix, doing so resulted in Very Bad Things™, such as the [document parser handling inference sub-fields as runtime fields and triggering assertion failures](https://github.com/Mikep86/elasticsearch/blob/516aa119453d97ec7ac58292e8a91642a5d75893/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/DocumentParser.java#L1039-L1039).
